en: A new age was to be born
Pierce the mountain ninety times
Name him Kenen
If she gives birth to Kenen
Night will fall over Talas
A soul known as Agyn’s son
Saying this one had been born
His enemies stretching beyond sight
He will conquer them in his breast
He will bend whoever confronts him
He will have the rest slaughtered
Your enemy’s peace
Now let Kenen prevail
The enemy before his eyes will shriek
If the leopard returns, Kenen’s land
All of it will be smashed to pieces
His roaming might will be great
The hero’s name will be mighty
He will be a dragonlike warrior
The earth’s mane will be seen
A magnanimous one greater than Beijing
A lineage from the khan’s own blood
A lineage born from a great people
A lark does not fear plain cloth
That one is Borun Teñir
He fears no torment
Our mother Kurt whom we saw
If the day comes to speak decisively
He will be a hero above others
His nature is that of an orator
That warrior will settle the people’s affairs
That is the hero whose sight brings fortune
To all his people against the foe
Across many lands in his time
Saying, here is my son Kenen
If entered in the race, he has fortune
Cast into fire, he will not burn
Against the enemy from Oron
He will not cease from destroying them
His world will reach many
The unwitting Chinese will lose their lives
This decree that was given
From the mouth of white-blessed Cheytek
He gave its sign as a trust
See the dwelling that was granted
Raise and watch the floating banner
So he may ride hard into holy war
Like lords who built paradise
Resourceful since birth
His grieving form was there in the dust
Straight before dark eyes
A human creature
There upon the ground before choosing eyes
The kulan among the countless herd
A great Kalmyk departed from the clan
Askar of Kojobay
Kylkara of the sickle-bearing people
The blue tongue of the gray-eyed one
A bare secret among a thousand
The burden of an evil claim
They joined battle with those men
They fought with the Chinese
He was greatly blessed
There was a mark upon the wolf
Coming swiftly from the diviners
Swift horses with noble bearing
Wondering if his third eye was keen
His gold shone so brightly
His banner went into the tumult
Many ancestors protected him
His stride stretched like a fox’s
By God’s decree the day arrived
It will swiftly come upon this people
The mist-gray pacer gives chase
This is the one touched by sunlight
The seal of his eye is a blazing peak
When seen, he multiplies into a thousand
A soul touched by the blue saint
His paths will not be constrained by foes
If they say he shrinks from the enemy
No lone people will escape him
If you do not speak calmly, he errs
For my young lord Kenen
The brave Joltoy is entrusted
As a trust I gave a horse
I gave a horse like a dragon
I told the secret to the root lineage
I described its crane-like form
Without telling others, he growled
My child, this is Joltoy
I spoke faithfully of your acquaintance
Attend to the words I spoke
He became a man and a hero
To warriors who had gone astray
To the sacred clan
Ten followed behind him
If you are the peerless heir
Joltoy, heed the spoken word
Advance, Joltoy, when driven
You are the eye of the true gray wolf
Heroic gray wolf Seyteke
You are the true heir
I set out for the hunt
Wisdom beyond counting
Saying he would see the famed face
Saying he would deliver his trust
How I have sought you
May what you seek be accepted
The enemy who opposes you
Dear Joltoy, I shall find him
Tears pressed down from grief
His brow opened through the night
Concerning the passage of days
The Creator directs your striving
I came with your eagle
My child Joltoy, into your hand
This creature with the bay charger
Even if I send it, you will give it
Receive the trust
That beast gave birth; those are its bones
It gave up its living head
Bareback, it swiftly settled
The gray pacer stood ready
Three hundred with its herd
Swaying as the wells joined
To the foal promised as a gift
Its head turned toward the enemy
To the foal they said would never yield under saddle
Traveling for many days
No charger can surpass it for you
So spoke Ak Joltoy
He overtook the fleeing through the night
Entrust these things
That man who stood speaking
He gave the trust before closing his eyes
Do not let it stand bareback
Along the rough road from the beginning
Then hero Joltoy
Subdued the raging ones
The course of days began
The hero’s heart rejoiced
He cast his gaze upon delight
Taking the gift before their eyes
They found the sword on the road
Ak Kulak of Joltoy
Clinging as he mounted the stallion
They met without turning aside
Joltoy traveled along the road
See what he did
He had descended from the enemy
He kept striking again and again
See him among the countless men
Plain cloth returns from the blue roan
A shield of blue gold was fastened
Taking a letter from the khan’s noble
Returning with a blessing from the elder
From the encounter, [?] is entrusted,
Before it could fully meet your eyes,
Hero Joltoy did not stir,
Saying nothing [?] to one who feared,
It does not reach his anguish,
Saying, “It is the eye of your ancestral spirit,”
Dear Joltoy says nothing to his face,
Oh, to the steed Kulunsur,
In the ancient [?] veil,
Saying, “It is enough if he sees,”
The steed turned its head,
There are Russians on your right hand,
In the direction he went there is the brown one,
All of you are there straight ahead,
There is an enemy [?] lying in wait.
If the yellow ridge roars,
How many lives can bear its weight,
If brave Jeken is a tiger today,
In one deed [?], in one place,
All men’s fingers,
The stratagem of the few,
Akjoltoy, I know the enemy,
Will your wolf come against our brow,
Will a fearsome trap come upon us,
The secret word lying unknown,
Will it come near from the stranger,
And saying, “If God wills,”
Murmuring and smiling,
Kulunsur’s [?] stood there,
Akjoltoy, rejoicing,
Murmuring to himself,
Talking to himself,
As though his mountain-like heart steadied,
He roused himself, saying, “I take the risk,”
Saying, “Today it will come upon a man,”
He gave thanks to God,
There the open steppe was exposed,
Saying, “Today the campaign will confound his mind.”
Travelling the road with the moon’s sorrow,
With much conflict and grievance,
Ah, the hero who continued from summer,
If there were a deed allowing him respite,
They settled and gathered in opposition,
A thousand bazaars, so many cities,
The thoughtful living man had learned,
Joltoy sets out upon the road to battle,
Night yielded to dawn as day broke,
When four full days had passed,
On this side of the sheltering rock,
To Kara-Buura itself,
Bloodthirsty Manas watched the road,
Toward the company going out to promenade,
Joltoy now arrived safely,
The open road of argali and wild rams,
Joltoy now went onward,
The watching sheep rustled,
He went on without holding back,
Their hearts pounding against the earth,
The enemy [?] began to move,
The earth split as dawn broke,
Like one left over from the night,
The sacred gray pouch,
Filling the pouch with [?],
Into the formidable saddlebag,
Forty spans [?] cut,
The gray pouch with its mouth folded over,
The pouch befriended by the bloodthirsty warrior,
The pouch, a companion since Manas,
Of the [?] pouch,
Made and adorned by its maker,
Its saddlebag saturated with glowing ornament,
When it gleamed upon the [?] surface,
What was his name,
His name was the saint Khızır,
Joined through these words,
To the sacred pouch,
Joltoy had evidently made ready.
Inside that pouch,
There was no [?] spoken of for this,
And if counted, it reached a thousand,
Nothing there would remain,
A person bereft of spiritual strength,
With cheerful laughter in the heart,
That hero was there at that time.
See the meaning of these words, my child
She bit her lip and trembled
Without speaking of what struck her, she cried
She folded like a sharp blade
Bringing sorrow upon ninety tribes
His setting forth tomorrow
Bowing her head to the ground
First, Joltoy, your rear is bloodied
Your departure has stretched long
She suffered so greatly
Longing for your departure
When the arriving eagle was recognized
Your sign cast a shadow
So spoke Ak Bermet
The hero’s charger stretched forward
Her uncle stood between them
